name: Scott Galloway
summary: Scott Galloway is named in 2 Parts of The Buildout, most recently Part 17: The Guarantee Has No Date. Argued in Part 17 (The lease is already debt).

parts.headline: The Bubble Is in the Denominator

mentions.excerpt: Scott Galloway ties AI fragility to the absence of regulation and says its reach extends beyond a handful of shares: the Magnificent Seven make up a third of the index, while the buildout drove a 32% increase in S&P earnings growth this year.

sides.claim: Investors are not paying sufficient attention to off-balance-sheet obligations that underlie Big Tech's artificial intelligence infrastructure spending.
